evidence_quote: Days to learn the words / Words Bo needs to learn = Words Bo needs to learn per day
question_evidence_quote: He has 40 days to learn the rest.  How many words does he need to learn a day?
observed_error: The response divides days by remaining words to calculate words per day.
violated_condition: Words per day must equal remaining words divided by available days.
error_description: The response reverses the daily-rate relation, dividing 40 days by 640 remaining words instead of dividing words by days. The written division is evaluated correctly, but its result has units of days per word, so labeling it words per day violates the requested quantity.
